templates.question: How often do strong drafters splash?
templates.source: Historical 17Lands aggregate; retained trophy deck catalogs
templates.method: Historical game-weighted rate is preserved. Separate stored-corpus topic measures one last recorded deck per matched trophy source; never equate the two populations.

templates.question: When do extra copies stay out of the deck?
templates.method: Among repeated-card groups with any observed deck inclusion, share where fewer copies appear than drafted; maximum observed count across games.

templates.question: When do drafters take fixing?
templates.method: Known ordinary land producing at least two colors offered beside a non-fixing alternative; per-pick conditional choice rates on qualified trophy drafts. Predefined P1P1 vs P1P5 triage.
templates.status: adapter written: pinned FRA archive; awaiting raw-data run

templates.question: How does fixing relate to splashing?
templates.method: Compare observed splash rates by drafted fixing and pick timing; stratify set, archetype and data coverage.

templates.question: Which cards get splashed?
templates.method: Describe extra-color cards by pip intensity, mana value and role; account for duplicates and unknown modes.
templates.requirements: explicit mana requirements, observed deck colors

templates.question: How often does a first pick miss the final deck?
templates.source: Pack One retained trophy picks + last-recorded deck catalogs
templates.method: Among complete first-eight verified trophy trajectories, name appears in main deck versus only sideboard of matched last recorded game; not first-game inclusion or copy-level.
templates.status: stored-corpus adapter: implemented; pending full validation

templates.question: When do drafters change direction?
templates.source: Pack One retained verified trophy trajectories
templates.method: At least two prior ordinary colored spells of one color, both same-color and new-color choices offered; P1P3 vs P1P6.
templates.status: stored-corpus adapter: implemented; pending full validation

templates.question: How often do early gold cards make the deck?
templates.method: Compare gold and mono-color picks within set, real pick range and comparable strength; no causal estimate.

templates.question: When do strong players pass a rare for a common?
templates.source: Pack One retained verified trophy picks
templates.method: Common and rare/mythic nonland alternatives offered; conditional real P1P1 vs P1P5.
templates.status: stored-corpus adapter: implemented; pending full validation

templates.question: How early do drafters take removal?
templates.method: Conditional selection rate when removal is offered; stratify set, mana cost and pick.

templates.question: When does curve begin to matter?
templates.method: Compare mana-value choices by earlier pool curve and availability; match color and pick.

templates.question: Do drafters prioritize two-drops after a slow start?
templates.source: Pack One retained verified trophy picks
templates.method: Compare taking ordinary two-mana creatures when both a two-mana and a higher-cost creature are offered at P1P1 and P1P5.
templates.status: stored-corpus adapter: implemented; pending full validation

templates.question: When are build-arounds followed by enablers?
templates.method: Track verified build-around/enabler pairs against stage-matched opportunities; exploratory, not synergy proof.

templates.question: How often are late strong cards followed by a color shift?
templates.method: Describe pick trajectories after late available strong cards; not evidence about unseen table signals.

templates.question: How early are flexible cards picked?
templates.source: Pack One retained verified trophy picks
templates.method: Generic-mana ordinary spell versus colored spell when both offered; P1P1 vs P1P5. Does not classify alternate costs or strategic flexibility.
templates.status: stored-corpus adapter: implemented; pending full validation

templates.question: Do trophy drafts stay open longer?
templates.method: Compare defined color commitment measures in qualified trophy and non-trophy cohorts; descriptive, matched set.

templates.question: Which early high-strength cards are left out?
templates.method: Compare early card inclusion with independently measured strength; use nonoverlapping assessment where feasible.

templates.question: How does fixing priority differ in Cube?
templates.method: Compare actual opportunities within compatible formats; report opening-pack gaps and selection limitations.

templates.question: Which sets reward staying open?
templates.method: Compare descriptive color breadth and inclusion across formats; do not infer rewards without outcome analysis.

templates.question: How late do powerful cards go?
templates.method: Availability by real pick number for predeclared high-strength cards; avoid survivor-bias claims.

templates.question: Where does the community differ from trophy drafters?
templates.source: Pack One aggregate responses + trophy corpus
templates.method: Plurality matches trophy or another card; explicit ties, first encounters, selected-puzzle bias.
templates.requirements: aggregate votes and frozen puzzle provenance

templates.question: Are players less willing to switch colors?
templates.source: Pack One aggregate responses + trophy corpus
templates.method: Compare community and trophy off-color choices on same offered cards; stratify prior pool and stage.

templates.question: Do players favor rare cards more often?
templates.source: Pack One aggregate responses + trophy corpus
templates.method: Compare rarity choices among identical available alternatives; equal puzzle weighting, no correctness inference.

templates.question: Which drafting dilemmas split players three ways?
templates.source: Pack One aggregate responses + trophy corpus
templates.method: Third-ranked share threshold defined ahead; cluster by source and stratify selected set/pick.
